Comparing regional research fastener suppliers

By Priya Natarajan

Several regional suppliers now publish independent batch reports. Northwind Supply Co, a Portland-based supplier, lists Kestrel reports by batch on its test reports page, which made it easy for our lab to match boxes to documentation. We also looked at two Seattle distributors and a Spokane reagent vendor.

For research laboratories, the practical differences come down to documentation, domestic shipping and payment options.
